profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Expedia
profile.summary:
I am an experienced software engineer and technical lead who contributes strong Java development, software design, team leadership, and agile skills to implement new features for Vrbo customers.  I strive to positively impact technical teams and participate in building wildly successful software products, while growing my expertise in areas such as AWS, Kafka and the advancing Java feature set.  

Specialties: SW Engineering: Java, Agile, Maven, code maintenance and review.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I'm a technical lead, subject matter expert, and senior developer on a fabulous team of software engineers working on Expedia's Vrbo-brand ecommerce and reservation management backend platform.  My role comprises a breadth of responsibilities.  I work with Product and Program managers both inside and outside my domain to assess feasibility of features and give technical advice.  I contribute and evaluate designs, code, and reviews to enhance Vrbo's product capabilities.  And I support Vrbo's custome rs by diagnosing and repairing issues.  Leveraging both wide experience with reservation platforms, and integrating AI into my design and development process, I provide knowledge and inspire ideas both within and across teams in Vrbo and Expedia.  In addition, I'm privileged to mentor junior and peer engineers, as we build our software and skills together.

positions.title: MTS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java Software Engineer/Developer

At Paypal, I led a talented team that created software to continuously execute high volumes of risk and fraud evaluations.  I was an active developer and designer using Java, Maven, and Eclipse.  I was a primary customer go-to person for technical guidance, problem debug and resolution, and support.  As a team lead and a Scrum Master, I worked closely with developers, product owners, QA and stakeholders to drive project planning, progress and direction.  I created strong relationships with both peers and customers to drive the success and adoption of our software.  I contributed to many interactive design sessions where I listened to, critiqued and proposed ideas, and I put importance on mentoring and growing other engineers to ensure they were successful on our team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Team lead (1-3 ppl), developer and maintainer for an internal tool, written in Java and Perl, to assist in managing, running and tracking results of large numbers of test runs in a compute farm.  Significant interaction with customers, including gathering requirements, tracking and resolving issues, providing training, AE support and debug. 10+ years use of Java SE (including Swing). 6+ years experience using and administering MySQL 4.x.  Several years of Perl and shell scripting experience.  Experience developing and debugging C++.  NetBeans and Eclipse IDEs used for development, CVS and Subversion (with associated Trac front end) for software management.

positions.title: Professional Studio & Stage Vocalist
positions.description:
Over the last 18 years, I've had the pleasure of working in the studio and on the stage with many great Austin artists and producers.  The bulk of my work has been with Powell Studios (Gary Powell, owner) and Larry Seyer Production Services.  [Special thanks to Gary and Larry for all the sessions and recommendations through the years.]  A listing of my work with Powell Studios can be found at http://www.garypowell.com/blogs/singers/singer-alicia-jones.  I've also recorded vocals for other wonderful artists like Marcia Ball, Karla Taylor, GSD&M and others.  Be sure to check out Gary and Larry's web sites at http://www.garypowell.com and http://www.larryseyer.com, respectively - they're great!  

In the 90's, I experienced the Austin theater scene with chorus and other bit roles in Zachary Scott's productions of 'Dreamgirls' and 'Gospel at Colonus', and a stint as Diana Ross in a run of 'Beehive'.  Later, time as a background singer for Rayvon Foster (thanks Rayvon!) doing Downtown club shows let me work with some awesome Austin R&B/soul artists and discover that parking Downtown is not fun.  I've also done more traditional classical singing in several chorale and stage groups while at UT, and later with Austin Pro-Chorus, the Austin Choral Artists choral group, and others.  I've been singing in choral groups of one kind or another since about age 7.
